SCRIPT.KOREAN: 야자 쉬는 시간 짧으니까 빨리 가자.
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Break time’s short, so let’s go quickly.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 晚自习休息时间很短，我们快去吧
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 晚自習的休息時間很短，快點走啦
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 夜自習の休み時間短いから早く行こ
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Waktu istirahatnya bentar tau jadi ayo buruan.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: O recreio é curto, então vamos logo.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: El resceso es corto, así que apurémonos.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: زمان استراحت کوتاه است، پس سریع برویم.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Ugh, I’m feeling lazy~
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: あ〜めんどくさい〜
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ah, que preguiça~
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اوه، من احساس تنبلی می کنم

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Come on, hurry~
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 早く〜
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Anda logo.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: بیا، عجله کن~

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: I was just gonna go to the store!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 我本来是想去小卖部的！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 売店行くつもりだったのに！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Tadi aku mau ke koperasi, tau!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Eu queria ir na cantina comprar alguma coisa!
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¡Quería ir a la tienda a comprar algo!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: من فقط می خواستم به فروشگاه بروم!

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 그럼 얼짱 빨리 보고 내가 매점에서 빵 사줄게
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Then I’ll let you see the school beauty quickly, and I’ll buy you some bread at the store.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 那看完校花我就去小卖部给你买面包
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 那我們快點看完那個美女，去福利社買麵包給你
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: じゃあそのかわいい子見てから私がパン買ってあげる
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Yaudah, nanti aku tunjukin si primadonanya-nya cepet-cepet, terus aku beliin roti di koperasi.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Se você for comigo, eu compro pão pra você na loja.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Si me acompañas, yo te compro pan en la tienda
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: سپس به شما اجازه می دهم که زیبایی مدرسه را به سرعت ببینید و از فروشگاه برای شما نون می خرم.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Alright, deal?
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: それでいいでしょ？
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Combinado?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: باشه، معامله؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Got it.
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: わかったよ
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Tá bom.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: متوجه شدم.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Looks like first‑year, class 1 is over there. Let’s go quickly.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 一年级一班应该在那边，快点走
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 一年一班好像在那裡！快點
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 1年1組 あそこじゃない？ 早く
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Kayaknya kelas 1-1 ada di sana tuh. Ayo cepet ke sana.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ali fica a sala 1 do primeiro ano. Vamos.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Por allá está la clase 1 de 1er año. Vamos.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: به نظر می رسد سال اول، کلاس 1 اونجاست. سریع برویم

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 아, 어딨지... 안 보이네 넌 보여?
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Ah, where…? I don’t see them. Can you?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 啊，在哪儿呢...没看到啊，你看见了吗？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 嗯...在哪裡呢...我沒看到，你有看到嗎？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: あ、どこ…見えない あんた見える？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Ah, mana…? Aku nggak liat siapa-siapa. Kamu liat?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ah, onde ela tá...? Não tô vendo. Você tá vendo?
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Ah, ¿dónde está...? No la veo. ¿Tú la ves?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: آه کجا…؟ من اونا رو نمی بینم می توانید؟

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 아... 야자 시간까지 이런 데 와야 돼?
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Ugh, do we really have to come here during break?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 唉...晚自习时间我们跑到这里来干嘛？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 唉，連晚自習時間都要跑來這種地方嗎？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: あ〜夜自習の時間にこんなとこ来なきゃいけないんだ？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Ugh, emang harus banget sih ke sini pas istirahat?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: A gente precisava mesmo vir até aqui no intervalo?
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¿De verdad tenemos que venir hasta aquí en el descanso?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اوه، واقعاً باید در زمان استراحت به اینجا بیاییم؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Come on...
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ほんと…
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Sério...
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: بیا...

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Ah, found them!
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: あ、見つけた！
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ah, achei!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: آه، اونا رو پیدا کردم!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Where??
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: どこ？？
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Onde??
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: کجا؟؟

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 아 저기에 창가에 귤 먹는 애 보이잖아...!
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Ah, over there by the window, see the kid eating a tangerine…!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 就在那里，窗边那个在吃橘子的女生，看见没...！
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 那邊，你沒看到嗎，就是那個在窗戶旁邊吃橘子的孩子...！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: あそこ 窓際でみかん食べてる子見えるでしょ…！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Tuh, di deket jendela, liat deh anak yang lagi makan jeruk itu…!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ali, perto da janela, a que tá comendo tangerinas...!
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¡Allá, junto a la ventana, la que está comiendo mandarinas...!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: آه، اون طرف پنجره، بچه را ببین که نارنگی می خورد…!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: You’re Bang Gyu‑ri?
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 君がパン・ギュリ？
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Você é a Bang Gyuri?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: شما بانگ گیوری هستید؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: The one who made a name for herself at Milk?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 听说你在牛奶初中很有名？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 聽說你在 Milk 國中小有名氣？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ミルク中でちょっと名前知られてたって？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Yang dulu sempet terkenal di Milk?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Aquela de quem todo mundo tá falando?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اونی که تو میلک برای خودش اسم و رسمی پیدا کرد؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Huh?
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: はい？
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: ها؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Uh?
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: え？
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Uh?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اوه؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Senior?
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: あ、先輩？？
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Você é...?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: ارشد؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Senio???
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 先輩？
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Quem me ajudou de manhã?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: سنیو؟؟؟

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 선배가 여긴 무슨 일로 오신 거예요?
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: What brings a senior to the first‑year classroom?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 学长来这里是有什么事吗？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 學長是為了什麼來這裡呢？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 先輩がこんなとこにどうして？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Ngapain kakak kelas ke kelas satu sih?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: O que você tá fazendo aqui?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: چه چیزی یک سالمند را به کلاس درس سال اول می آورد؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Ah, I was just passing by…
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: あ〜俺はただ通りかかって…
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Ah, aku cuma lagi lewat doang…
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ah, bom, eu só tava passando por aqui...
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Ah, bueno, yo solo pasaba por aquí...
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: آخه من داشتم می گذشتم…

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 3학년이 1학년 교실에 그냥 올 일 없을 텐데~
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: A third‑year normally wouldn’t come into a first‑year classroom~
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 高三生应该不会没事来一年级教室吧~
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 三年級的學生不會沒事就跑到一年級教室來吧～
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 3年が1年の教室に用もなく来るわけないのに〜
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Anak kelas tiga biasanya nggak bakal masuk ke kelas satu gini loh~
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Um aluno do terceiro ano não viria até aqui “só por vir”~
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Un alumno de 3er año no vedría hasta aquí “solo porque sí”~
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: یک سال سوم معمولاً وارد کلاس اول نمی شود

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Wait… you two know each other?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 什么呀？你们两个认识啊？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: なに 二人知り合いなの？
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: O que foi? Vocês se conhecem?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: صبر کن...شما دوتا همدیگه رو میشناسید؟
